reviewer.role: independent bounded CODE-PROOF retained-I/O clarification reviewer

verdict: R8 closes the seven R6 review findings at the design level. It adds a usable layout_state accessor, keeps failed scans private, moves lazy creation into the retained install phase, freezes directory modes and ordinary-entry caps, rejects ordinary-input/resource overlap, separates names/set checks from full byte rereads, records the authorized final before directory fsync, and supplies conservative link/unlink post-effect reconciliation plus deterministic error-group ordering. One implementation edge remains: mkdir/post-stat syscalls that raise after creating a directory lack the same explicit post-effect refusal row supplied for link and unlink. The absent resource hashes and generated schemas remain an intentional external freeze gate.
scope: Read-only review of CODE-PROOF-RETAINED-CLARIFICATIONS-R8 against CODE-PROOF-RETAINED-IO-R6, its independent review, and the inherited R2-R7 retained-I/O decisions. No source, schema, test, fixture, Git, provider, network, connector, Vault or prior-evidence mutation.

closure_matrix.evidence: R8 lines 9-39 adds layout_state with initial/current namespace and family presence, sorted valid files and current bytes, while keeping failed scan state private. This is sufficient for R5 status classification without reopening paths.

R8 lines 40-65 make install own lazy .work/batch/output creation after semantic preflight, retain earliest missing edges, lock first, create 0700 directories descriptor-relatively, and never use an orchestrator side channel.

R8 lines 87-101 reject ordinary input equal/inside/ancestor relations and descriptor aliases, and require all selected resource origins to remain disjoint from output. The retained raw-bundle disjointness is preserved.
R8 lines 66-86 freeze exact 0700 output/family modes, ordinary caps, one owned-temp allowance and cap+sentinel enumeration bounds, with stat-size charging before classification.
R8 lines 103-123 define verify_names_and_sets for every write/transition and verify_full at bounded acquisition/publication/final checkpoints; full rereads no longer scale with short-write count.

R8 lines 125-151 explicitly reconcile link and unlink exceptions, retain successful-link flags, refuse ambiguous finals, preserve owned-temp evidence and avoid rollback/adoption. The corresponding mkdir/post-stat exception is not enumerated; see R8-MKDIR-001.
R8 lines 153-190 freeze eight group order, per-group selection, lineage precedence, cleanup precedence, bounded details, reverse descriptor close and interruption behavior.

findings.title: mkdir/post-stat syscall post-effect exceptions lack an explicit reconciliation row
findings.evidence: R8 lines 43-65 require mkdir followed by capture/open/check and authorize the created directory, while lines 125-151 provide explicit post-effect tables only for link and unlink. The final sentence at line 151 says mkdir/post-stat observations retain R6 limitations but does not state the outcome when mkdir raises after creating the directory or when post-stat raises after a replacement.
findings.risk: An implementation could treat a mkdir exception as an ordinary operation error, then either adopt a directory that appeared after the captured absence or roll back/delete a directory whose ownership is ambiguous. That would violate the conservative no-adoption/no-rollback rule and make the first-install state non-deterministic.
findings.required_closure: Add a mkdir/post-stat row: any mkdir exception with the named directory present is an unverified late arrival unless the retained edge and exact mode/identity are provably the command's creation; refuse and never delete/adopt it. A post-stat exception or missing directory must preserve the setup/operation error, run final lineage checks, and leave only verified owned empty directories. Test injected mkdir and post-mkdir stat failures.

findings.title: The retained design still cannot be implementation-accepted without resource/schema bytes
findings.evidence: R8 lines 1-7 and 191-193 explicitly preserve the requirement for ten public schemas, an installed profile, reason/context tables and exact resource hashes. R8 closes the retained resource relation and error handling, but supplies no material bytes or hash set.
findings.risk: A correct retained session could still bind a missing, extra or wrong-origin resource generation if the generated files and source/installed parity are not frozen before implementation acceptance.
findings.required_closure: Generate the ten schemas and profile, record exact hashes and origins, bind them to the retained resource set, and verify isolated wheel parity. This is an external public-wire gate rather than a defect in the R8 phase model.

required_next_freezes: Add the conservative mkdir/post-stat post-effect matrix and tests before private I/O implementation acceptance.
Generate and hash the ten public schemas/profile and retain their exact source/installed origins.
Implement the stopped R8 session with the two verification cadences, phase transitions, close ordering and no legacy installer reuse, then run the complete adversarial table and full wheel suites.
